text.content: Upgrade the Contigo support agent from a basic conversational chain to a RAG-powered pipeline by connecting a vector store, attaching an embedding model, and enforcing grounded responses through the system prompt.

text.content: Contigo GmbH's support agent has memory, session isolation, and a well-designed retention policy. What it still cannot do is retrieve. When a client asks about Contigo's SME loan products, the agent draws on the language model's general training rather than the actual product documentation.
